paper_title: Resonant detection of axion mediated forces with Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
notes: Projection (not a measured limit) for a proposed NMR-based resonant search for axion-mediated CP-violating spin-dependent forces. Fig. 2 shows the monopole-dipole reach |g_s^N g_p^N| vs force range (0.01-10 cm), independent of axion dark-matter abundance. X-axis converted from Compton wavelength (force range in cm) to axion mass via m_a = hbar*c/lambda = 1.973e-7 eV*m / lambda; the paper states this corresponds to m_a ~ 1e-6 to 1e-3 eV (f_a 1e9-1e12 GeV). Coupling values are approximate readings of the projected 'setup in this paper'/ultimate reach curves from the log plot and are uncertain. Paper also presents dipole-dipole (g_pN^2/4pi and g_pN g_pe/4pi) reach in Fig. 3, not extracted here.
